company.name: Nebelus
company.shortDescription: Nebelus develops an agentic AI platform that uses natural language to automate workflows and execute tasks.
company.description: Nebelus is an agentic AI company that builds a platform for business users, allows them to create, deploy, and scale powerful artificial intelligence agents by using natural language without the need for coding or development. With the company's flagship AI Agent Studio, businesses can enhance every workflow with purpose-built AI Agents - securely governed and scaled - amplifying human impact and enhancing all workflows.

productsAndServices.description: Capability to connect and utilize multiple large language models within AI agents for enhanced task handling and language processing.
productsAndServices.name: Multi-Model Large Language Model (LLM) Integration
